objectives.description: Grep for residual folder:Gmail fallthrough and tag:<account> queries
Confirm bare /email path byte-for-byte unchanged (Gmail default)
Verify EXTENSION.md propagates to CLAUDE.md extension_email section
objectives.note: Mechanism/config verified correct; end-to-end propagation not observable because the email extension is not currently loaded in this repo's .claude/extensions.json (pre-existing, unrelated to task 815). See deviation.

deviations.description: Verify the EXTENSION.md additions propagate to .claude/CLAUDE.md's extension_email section via the sync/merge pipeline
deviations.reason: The email extension is not currently loaded in this repo (.claude/extensions.json lists only core, memory, nix, nvim), so .claude/CLAUDE.md has no Email Extension section to compare against, independent of this task. Verified instead that the merge config (manifest.json merge_targets.claudemd) and mechanism (generate_claudemd in lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua) are correctly structured to pick up the new EXTENSION.md content once the extension is loaded/synced by the user via the Neovim extension picker -- a user-driven, repo-wide-side-effect action out of scope for this headless implementation.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — verified merge mechanism/config correctness in place of unobservable end-to-end propagation; see phase progress note)*
